parameters.name: num_products
parameters.description: Number of products, with product index set {0,1,...,P-1}

parameters.name: num_resources
parameters.description: Number of renewable resource types, with resource index set {0,1,...,R-1}

parameters.name: num_periods
parameters.description: Number of planning periods, with period index set {0,1,...,T-1}

parameters.name: time_conversion_factor
parameters.description: Time conversion factor between the units used for processing times and capacities

parameters.name: processing_time_requirements
parameters.description: Per-batch processing time required for product p on resource r

parameters.name: resource_availability
parameters.description: Available capacity of resource r in period t

parameters.name: unit_revenue
parameters.description: Unit revenue per batch sold for product p

parameters.name: resource_operating_cost
parameters.description: Operating cost per hour for resource r

parameters.name: market_demand_upper_bound
parameters.description: Optional market demand upper bound for product p in period t; if absent, demand is nonbinding

parameters.name: contract_product_index
parameters.description: Index of the product subject to the minimum contract requirement

parameters.name: minimum_contract_quantity
parameters.description: Minimum required quantity of the contract product in each period

variables.name: production_quantity
variables.description: Number of standardized batches of product p produced in period t, with fractional values allowed

constraints.name: nonnegative_production_quantity
constraints.description: Production quantities must be nonnegative and fractional values are allowed.

constraints.name: resource_capacity_limit
constraints.description: For each resource r and period t, total processing time used by all products cannot exceed the available capacity, after applying the time conversion factor.

constraints.name: contract_minimum_quantity
constraints.description: The designated contract product must be produced in at least the required minimum quantity in every period.

constraints.name: demand_upper_bound_if_provided
constraints.description: If market demand data are provided, sales of each product in each period cannot exceed the given demand upper bound; because production and sales are identical, this is enforced directly on production quantities.

constraints.name: production_equals_sales
constraints.description: All produced batches are sold in the same period, so production quantities and sales quantities are identical and there is no inventory carryover. This is enforced structurally by using only the production variable and no separate sales or inventory variables.
constraints.formula: \text{No separate sales variable; } s_{p,t} = x_{p,t} \text{ is implicit for all } p=0,\ldots,P-1,\; t=0,\ldots,T-1

objectives.name: profit_maximization
objectives.description: Maximize total profit over the planning horizon, defined as total revenue from sold batches minus total resource operating cost.

final_objective.description: Maximize total profit over the planning horizon, equal to total revenue from produced-and-sold batches minus total resource operating cost. Since production equals sales and no inventory is carried, revenue is linear in production quantities and resource cost is charged on utilized processing time.
